events.text: Implementation authorized: reopening the prior diagnosis to add the SDL modifier bridge and verify it.

Added the native getMouseMods bridge backed by SDL_GetModState and registered it with the core V8 binding surface. Pointer payload construction now decodes the shared SDL3 modifier masks into shiftKey, ctrlKey, altKey, and metaKey; the runtime consolidation landed in the adjacent shared commit while staging, and this request's native/generated binding delta is f5cc536d5. Rebuilt the editor successfully and confirmed generated binding metadata is clean. Visual interaction verification remains for the user.

resolution: Confirmed the user's test result and found the root cause: shift-click multi-select is DEAD ON ARRIVAL. The chain is fully wired JS-side (WorldViewport.tsx:606 additive: !!e?.shiftKey → selectPiece additive → selectedPieceIds → facadeFromSelection), but the pointer event payload the runtime builds (runtime/index.tsx getPointerPayload:385) contains NO shiftKey field — only targetId/x/y/button/pressure/buttons — and no host getter exposes SDL modifier state to JS pointer events at all (engine.zig reads SDL_GetModState natively for its own gizmo paths only). So !!e?.shiftKey is always false, additive select can never fire, and the only reachable facade scope is the single-piece gatherFacade branch — exactly what the user has been experiencing while the req_3062/3063 index record claims shift-click works. The gesture was never once driven end-to-end before being reported shipped. Fix (awaiting go, needs Zig rebuild so not done during the live session): expose modifier state (host getter reading SDL_GetModState), add shiftKey/ctrlKey/altKey to getPointerPayload, verify by actually shift-clicking two pieces into a facade. No code changed.
